Mary and Joseph present the Child to the: Maria na Yosefe batuula Shikulu Umwana. Simeoni amusenda mu maboko yakwe, amwita «ulubuuto ulwa kulabuushako inko», kabili aeba Maria ukuti ulupanga lukatuula umutima wakwe.
Warned in a dream, Saint Joseph rises by: Ilyo asokwa mu ciloto, Santu Yosefe abuka ubushiku no kusenda Umwana na nyina ku Egupti, ukutali ne kuboko kwa kwa Herode, pa kuti cifikilishiwe icebo ca kuti: «Naitile umwana wandi ukufuma mu Egupti» (Hosea 11:1).

At twelve He stays behind in Jerusalem a: Ali ne myaka ikumi na ibili, ashala mu Yerusalemu pa numa ya Pasaka. Pa bushiku bwa butatu, Maria na Yosefe bamusanga pa kati ka bakasambilisha: «Bushe tamwaishibe ukuti ndi no kuba mu fya kwa Tata?»
For some thirty years He lives at Nazare: Pa myaka nalimo amakumi yatatu aikala mu Nazarete, aleumfwila Maria na Yosefe, alebomba umulimo wa bukafundi wa mapulanga, kabili alekula mu mano, mu butali na mu kusenamina pa menso ya kwa Lesa na bantu.

Moved with pity for a widow burying her: Alanguluka umukamfwilwa uwali ukushiika umwana wakwe umo rukoso, akumya pa cisendelo: «Mulumendo, ndekweba, ima!» kabili amubwesesha kuli nyina.

He smears clay on the eyes of a man blin: Asubila ilongo ku menso ya muntu uwafyelwe impofu no kumutuma ukusamba mu cishiba ca Siloamu. Abwela alemona kabili amupepa: «Shikulu, ndecetekela.»
Martha welcomes Him while Mary sits at H: Marta amupokelela, lelo Maria aikala ku makasa yakwe alekutika. «Maria asalile icipande icisuma, kabili tacakafumishiwe kuli wene.»

When a disciple asks Him to teach them t: Ilyo umo uwa basambi amulomba ukubasambilisha ukupepa, abapeela ipepo lya Tata Wesu.
Luke does not name the place; tradition: Luka talanda incende; intambi shibukisha ifi mu bulindi bwa Eleona pa Mupili wa Olivi. Mateo apeela ili pepo mu Kushimikila pa Mupili (Matthew 6:9-13).
Walking in the portico of Solomon in win: Enda mu cipango ca kwa Solomone mu nshita ya mpepo, no kutila: «Impaanga shandi shiumfwa ishiwi lyandi… Ine na Tata tuli bamo.»
Abwelela ku ncende uko Yohane alebatishisha pa kubalilapo. Asambilisha ukuti ico Lesa alundanya, umuntu ekalekanya, kabili apaala abana: «Lekeni abana abanono baise kuli ine.»
\"I am the resurrection and the life.\": «Nine kubuuka no mweo.» Yesu alila pa nshiinda ya kwa cibusa wakwe, pa numa apunda ne shiwi likalamba: «Lasaro, fuma!» kabili uwafwile afuma acili akakilwe mu fya kufwala.
As the council plots His death, He withd: Ilyo Icilye Cikalamba cilepanga ukumwipaya, afisama na basambi bakwe mu musumba uupalamine icinkupiti uwitwa Efraimu.
Blind Bartimaeus cries, \"Jesus, son of: Impofu Bartimeo ipunda ati: «Yesu, Mwana wa kwa Davidi, nkumbwila uluse!» kabili yamona. Sakeo aninina umuti wa mukuyu pa kuti amumone: «Lelo ubupusushi bwaisa muli iyi ng'anda.»

As He comes in sight of the city He weep: Ilyo amona umusumba, aulilila: «Kani na iwe waishibe lelo ifingakuletela umutende!»

Seated on the Mount of Olives facing the: Aikele pa Mupili wa Olivi ukulolenkana ne Tempele, alanda pa konaulwa kwalyo na pa kwisa kwakwe mu bukata: «Ico mwacitile umo uwa bamunyinane aba abanono, mwacitile ine.»

The Crucifixion and Death: Ukubambwa ne mfwa ya kwa Yesu

By a beloved tradition, the Blessed Virg: Ukulingana ne ntambi iyitemwikwa, Maria Nacisungu apeele Rosari kuli Santu Dominiko ku Prouille, mu Fransi, ku ntendekelo ya myanda ya myaka iya 13, pa kuti imwafwe mu kushimikila kwakwe ukulwisha ifisambilisho fya bufi ifya Ba-albigensi. Ibumba lyakwe, Ibumba lya Bashimikishi, lyaisalanganya mu Bwina Kristu bonse, kabili mu myanda ya myaka iya 15 Uwapaalwa Alano wa La Roche, umuDominikani, alengele ukupepa uku ukuba kupya kabili atendeke amabumba ya kubalilapo aya Rosari.
Pope Saint Pius V, himself a Dominican,: Santu Papa Pio V, na wene umuDominikani, apeele Rosari imipangilwe yaiko iya lyonse iya nkama ikumi na shisano, isha Nsansa, isha Bulanda ne sha Bukata, mu 1569. Pa numa ya kucimfya kwa ku Lepanto pa 7 Oktoba 1571, ukwasangilwe ilyo Ubwina Kristu bonse bwalepepa Rosari, alengele ubo bushiku ukuba umutebeto wa kwa Maria wa Kucimfya, nomba icibukisho ca kwa Maria Nacisungu wa Rosari. Ku Lourdes na ku Fatima, Nacisungu wine aishile na rosari kabili alombele ukuti ilepepwa cila bushiku.
On October 16, 2002, Pope Saint John Pau: Pa 16 Oktoba 2002, Santu Papa Yohane Paulo II alundilepo inkama shisano isha Lubuuto, ukufuma ku mweo wa kwa Shikulu wesu pa lwalala, mu kalata wakwe uwa butumwa Rosarium Virginis Mariae, pa kuti Rosari ibe «ica kufupikisha Landwe Lusuma». Muli cila nkama tutontonkanya pa cinso ca kwa Kristu ukulolesha ne menso ya kwa Nyina.

the Cedars of God, Kadisha Valley: Misedari ya kwa Lesa, mukonko wa Kadisha
The land God promised to Abraham, where: Icalo Lesa alaile Abrahamu, uko Israele aikele nga uluko, kabili uko Yesu afyalilwe, asambilishe, afwile no kubuuka. Abakatolika ilingi bacita ati “Ilyashi Lisuma lya busanu”.
Called Canaan when Abram arrives and God: Ilyo Abramu afikile calecitwa ati Kanaani, Lesa no kucilaya ku bana bakwe (Genesis 12:5-7).
Described as 'a land flowing with milk a: Ilyo Lesa aitile Mose, acicitile ati “icalo icaisulamo umukaka no buci” (Exodus 3:8).
Divided after Solomon into the northern: Pa numa ya kwa Solomone calyakene: ubufumu bwa Israele ku kapinda ka kuso no bufumu bwa Yuda ku kulyo (1 Kings 12:16-20).
In Jesus' time the regions were Judea, S: Mu nshiku sha kwa Yesu ifitungu fyali Yudea, Samaria na Galilea (Luke 17:11; John 4:3-4). Ishina Palestina lifuma ku Filistia, icalo ca Bafilisti (Exodus 15:14).
The Book of Judith is set in Bethulia, a: Icitabo ca kwa Yudite cicitikila mu Betulia, umusumba wa ku Samaria uushaishibikwa uko wali (Judith 4:6; Judith 6:10-11).
The Maccabees fought here for the freedo: Pano Abamakabe e po balwilile ubuntungwa bwa kusunga amafunde ya kwa Lesa, no kubwesha Itempele (1 Maccabees 2-4).
Since 1342 the Franciscans of the Custod: Ukutula mu 1342, Abafransiskani ba Bukaele bwa Calo ca Mushilo e basunga incende sha mushilo pa mulandu wa Calici ca Katolika.
The Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem serv: Patriarka wa Cilatini uwa ku Yerusalemu abomfya Abakatolika mu Israele, Palestina, Yordani na Kupro, pamo ne mabumba ya Macalici ya Katolika aya ku Kabanga: Abamelkiti, Abamaroni, Abasiria, Abaarmenia na bambi.
Popes Paul VI (1964), John Paul II (2000: Bapapa Paulo VI (1964), Yohane Paulo II (2000), Benedikto XVI (2009) na Fransisko (2014) bonse balisendele ulwendo lwa mushilo kuno.
Modern Iran was the heart of the Persian: Irani wa lelo e wali pa kati ka Bufumu bwa Persia. Imfumu yaiko Kuro Mukalamba yalekele Abayuda ukubwela ukufuma mu busha bwa ku Babele, kabili ifitabo fya kwa Estere, Tobiti na Yudite ficitikila muli ici cifulo.
Isaiah calls Cyrus, a pagan king, the Lo: Esaya aita Kuro, imfumu iishali ya Bayuda, ati “uwasubwa” wa kwa Shikulu, uwasalwa ukulubula abali mu bunkole (Isaiah 44:28; Isaiah 45:1-4).
Cyrus's decree lets the Jews go home and: Ifunde lya kwa Kuro lyalekele Abayuda ukubwelela ku mwabo no kukuula na kabili Itempele mu Yerusalemu (Ezra 1:1-4; 2 Chronicles 36:22-23). Ikope lyalyo lyasangilwe pa numa mu Ekbatana (Ezra 6:1-5).
Esther, a Jewish queen at the Persian co: Estere, namfumu umuYuda mu ng'anda ya bufumu ya ku Persia mu Susa, abikile umweo wakwe mu busanso pa kupususha abantu bakwe; e po umutebeto wa Purimu watendekele (Esther 4:14; Esther 9:20-32). Baibolo sha Katolika shalikwata ifipande fya ciGriki ifya kwa Estere, pamo ne mapepo ya kwa Mordekai na Estere.
Nehemiah is cupbearer to King Artaxerxes: Nehemia ali kapyungila wa nkombe ya mfumu Artakserkse mu Susa ilyo ashilaya ukukuula na kabili ifibumba fya Yerusalemu (Nehemiah 1:1; Nehemiah 2:1-8).
Daniel sees a vision at Susa, by the riv: Daniele amwene ifimonwa mu Susa, mu mbali ya mumana Ulai (Daniel 8:2).
Israelites taken by Assyria were settled: Abaisraele abatwelwe mu bunkole ku Asiria babikilwe “mu misumba ya Bamedi” (2 Kings 17:6). Ici e calo ca kwa Tobiti: umwana wakwe Tobia aendele no mumalaika Rafaele ukufika ku Ekbatana na ku Rage mu Media (Tobit 1:14; Tobit 3:7).
The Book of Judith opens with Arphaxad,: Icitabo ca kwa Yudite citendeka na Arfaksadi, imfumu ya Bamedi, uwakuulile ifibumba fya Ekbatana (Judith 1:1-4).
Elam, in the south-west, appears from Ab: Elamu wa ku kulyo ku masamba alumbulwa ukutula mu nshiku sha kwa Abrahamu (Genesis 14:1) ukufika ku bakasesema (Jeremiah 49:34-39).
Parthians, Medes and Elamites heard the: Pa Pentekoste, Abapati, Abamedi na Baelamu baumfwile abatumwa balelanda mu ndimi shabo (Acts 2:9).
The Magi 'from the east' (Matthew 2:1) b: Bakacenjela “abafumine ku Kabanga” (Matthew 2:1) bakwata ishina lya bashimapepo ba ku Persia. Ilyashi lya pa numa lilanda ati abacimfya ba ku Persia tabonawile Icalici ca Kufyalwa mu Betlehemu mu 614, pantu icikope caciko calangile Bakacenjela nabafwala ifya ku Persia.
Local tradition honours the tomb of the: Intambi sha kuno shicindika inshishi sha kasesema Daniele ku Shush (Susa wa kale), ne sha kwa Estere na Mordekai ku Hamadan (Ekbatana wa kale).
Catholics in Iran today belong to the Ch: Lelo Abakatolika ba ku Irani ba mu Macalici ya Bakaldea, Abaarmenia na ya Cilatini (Tehran-Isfahan).
The land between the Tigris and Euphrate: Icalo pa kati ka Tigrisi na Efrate. Abrahamu afumine ku Uri, Yona ashimikile ku Ninive, kabili Abayuda baikele mu bunkole ku mimana ya Babele.
The Tigris and Euphrates are named among: Tigrisi na Efrate ni ibili mu mimana ine iya mu Edeni (Genesis 2:10-14).
The tower of Babel is built in 'the land: Ulupungu lwa Babele lwakuulilwe “mu calo ca Shinari” (Genesis 11:1-9).
Abram's family leaves Ur of the Chaldean: Ulupwa lwa kwa Abramu lwafumine ku Uri wa Bakaldea (Genesis 11:31; Genesis 15:7).
Assyria, ruled from Nineveh, destroys th: Asiria, iyateka ukufuma ku Ninive, yonawile ubufumu bwa kuso ubwa Israele mu 722 ilyo Kristu ashilafyalwa (2 Kings 17:5-6). Babele yonawile Yerusalemu mu 587 ilyo Kristu ashilafyalwa (2 Kings 25:8-11).
The exiles weep 'by the rivers of Babylo: Abali mu bunkole balilile “ku mimana ya Babele” (Psalm 137). Esekiele amwene ifimonwa ku mumana Kebari (Ezekiel 1:1-3).
Tobit is a captive in Nineveh who buries: Tobiti ali mu bunkole ku Ninive uwashikile abafwa nangu ca kuti calebika umweo wakwe mu busanso (Tobit 1:3; Tobit 1:17-20).
Baruch, Jeremiah's scribe, reads his boo: Baruke, kalemba wa kwa Yeremia, abelengele abali mu bunkole ku Babele icitabo cakwe (Baruch 1:1-4).
People from Mesopotamia heard the Gospel: Abantu abafumine ku Mesopotamia baumfwile Ilyashi Lisuma pa Pentekoste (Acts 2:9).
Tradition says the apostle Thomas and hi: Ukulingana ne ntambi, Ilyashi Lisuma lyaletelwe kuno no mutumwa Tomasi na basambi bakwe Addai na Mari. Icalici ca Katolika ica Bakaldea, ico Patriarka waciko aba ku Baghdad, cipepa mu Liturgia iyo capyene ukufuma kuli ici Calici ca kale ica ku Kabanga.
Many Christians of the Nineveh Plains, i: Abena Kristu abengi aba mu mpanga ya Ninive, ukusanshako Abakatolika Abasiria aba ku Qaraqosh, batamfiwe ne Calo ca Bushilamu mu 2014.
Pope Francis made the first papal visit: Mu Malichi 2021, Papa Fransisko asendele ulwendo lwa kubalilapo ulwa Papa ku Iraki, kabili apepele ku Uri, Mosul na Qaraqosh.
Egypt was a place of refuge and of slave: Egupti calo ca kubutukilamo ne ca busha: uko Yosefe aishilekwata amaka, uko Israele aishileba abasha no kulubulwa mu Kufuma, kabili uko Ulupwa Lwa Mushilo lwabutukile Herode.
Abram goes down to Egypt in a famine (Ge: Abramu aliile ku Egupti pa mulandu wa cipowe (Genesis 12:10-20).
Joseph, sold by his brothers, becomes Ph: Yosefe, uo bamunyina bashitishe, aishileba kapitao wa ng'anda ya kwa Farao, ne lupwa lwa kwa Yakobo lwaikele ku Gosheni (Genesis 41:41-45; Genesis 47:27).
Israel is enslaved, building the store c: Israele aishileba abasha no kukuula imisumba ya kubikamo ifya kulya Pitomu na Ramesesi (Exodus 1:8-14). Lesa abalubwile ukupitila muli Mose no kwabuka Bemba Uwakashika (Exodus 12-14).
Isaiah foresees an altar to the Lord in: Esaya asesemene ulupili lwa kwa Shikulu mu Egupti, Lesa ati: “Ashalikwe Egupti, abantu bandi” (Isaiah 19:19-25).
Joseph, Mary and the child Jesus flee to: Yosefe, Maria no Mwana Yesu babutukiile ku Egupti ukufuma kuli Herode, pa kuti icebo cifikilishiwe: “Naitile Umwana wandi ukufuma mu Egupti” (Matthew 2:13-15; Hosea 11:1).
Ben Sira's grandson translated the Book: Umwishikulu wa kwa Ben Sira apilibwile icitabo ca kwa Sirake mu ciGriki ilyo afikile ku Egupti (Sirach, amashiwi ya kutendekelapo). Icipangano ca Kale mu ciGriki, Septuaginta, capangilwe ku Aleksandria kabili cakwata ifitabo Abakatolika baita ati Deuterokanoniko.
Tradition names St Mark the Evangelist a: Intambi shisumina ukuti Mutakatifu Marko Kalemba wa Ilyashi Lisuma e watendeke Icalici ca ku Aleksandria.
Christian monastic life began in the Egy: Umweo wa bamonaki aba bena Kristu watendekele mu matololo ya Egupti na Mutakatifu Antoni Abbate na Bawishi ba mu Matololo.
The Coptic Catholic Church is based in C: Icalici ca Katolika ica Bakopti cakwata icikulwa caciko ku Kairo. Intambi sha Bakopti shikonka inshila ya Lupwa Lwa Mushilo mu Egupti, ukusanshako ilinga ilya pe samba lya calici ca Bamutakatifu Sergio na Bakko mu Kairo wa Kale.
St John Paul II visited Mount Sinai in 2: Mutakatifu Yohane Paulo II atandalile Ulupili lwa Sinai mu 2000, na Papa Fransisko atandalile Egupti mu 2017.
East of the Jordan River lay Moab, Ammon: Ku kabanga ka Yordani kuli Moabu, Amoni, Edomu na Gileadi. Pano, pa Lupili Nebo, Mose e po amwenene Icalo ca Bulayo; Rute ali umuMoabu, na Yohane abatishe “ku lubali lumbi ulwa Yordani”.
Jacob wrestles with God at the ford of t: Yakobo alwile na Lesa pa cabuko ca Yaboki, no kupeelwa ishina ati Israele (Genesis 32).
Moses views the Promised Land from Mount: Mose alolesheshe Icalo ca Bulayo ilyo ali pa Lupili Nebo, no kufwila mu Moabu (Deuteronomy 34:1-6).
Ruth the Moabite, ancestor of David and: Rute umuMoabu, nakulu wa kwa Davidi na Yesu, asalile Lesa wa kwa Naomi (Ruth 1:16; Matthew 1:5).
Elijah came from Tishbe in Gilead (1 Kin: Elia ali umuTishbi uwa ku Gileadi (1 Kings 17:1). Uria afwile mu kushinga kwa Raba wa Baamoni, Amman wa lelo (2 Samuel 11:1-17).
Judas Maccabeus campaigns in Gilead to r: Yuda Makabe atungulwile abashilika ukuya ku Gileadi ukupususha Abayuda abaleikalako (1 Maccabees 5:9-54).
John baptizes at 'Bethany across the Jor: Yohane alebatisha “ku Betania ku lubali lumbi ulwa Yordani” (John 1:28). Yesu apitile mu Dekapoli (Mark 7:31).
The Jewish historian Josephus says John: Ukulingana na kalemba wa lyashi lya kale umuYuda Flavio Yosefe, Yohane Kabatisha aputwilwe umutwe mu cinga ca kwa Herode ica Makaerusi, ku kabanga ka Bemba wa Mucele (moneni Mark 6:17-29).
The baptism site at Bethany beyond the J: Incende ya lubatisho ku Betania ku lubali lumbi ulwa Yordani yatandalilwe na Bapapa Yohane Paulo II, Benedikto XVI na Fransisko.
The Marian shrine of Our Lady of the Mou: Incende ya mushilo iya kwa Mayo Wesu wa Lupili ku Anjar ilangulula intambi ya kuti Yesu, Maria na basambi batushishe kuno mu ilinga.
Ancient Aram, Israel's northern neighbou: Aramu wa kale, umwina mupalamano wa ku kuso uwa Israele. Saulo wa ku Tarso akumanine na Kristu Uwabuuka mu musebo wa ku Damasko, kabili mu nshiku sha kwa Yesu Siria wa Baroma wafikile na ku Antiokia.
Abraham's servant was Eliezer of Damascu: Umubomfi wa kwa Abrahamu ali Elieseri wa ku Damasko (Genesis 15:2).
Naaman, an Aramean general, is healed of: Naamani, kapitao wa bashilika umuAramu, asambile mu Yordani ukulingana ne cebo ca kwa Elisha, no kupola ku bulwele bwa nsoka (2 Kings 5:1-14).
Jesus' fame 'spread to all of Syria' (Ma: Ilyashi lya kwa Yesu “lyasalanganine mu Siria monse” (Matthew 4:24). Kirenio ali kateka wa Siria ilyo Yesu afyelwe (Luke 2:2).
Saul is blinded by the light of Christ o: Mu musebo wa ku Damasko, Saulo apofwile ku lubuuto lwa kwa Kristu, kabili abatishiwe mu musumba (Acts 9:1-19).
Villages such as Maaloula still speak a: Mu mishi nga Maalula bacilanda ciAramu, ululimi Yesu alelanda.
The Melkite Greek Catholic Patriarch has: Patriarka wa Calici ca Katolika ica Bamelkiti abaGriki aba ku Damasko. Siria yalikwata na Bakatolika Abasiria, Abamaroni, Abaarmenia na ba Cilatini.
St John Paul II prayed at the shrine of: Mutakatifu Yohane Paulo II apepele mu 2001 pa nshishi ya kwa Mutakatifu Yohane Kabatisha mu Mosque ya Baumayyadi ku Damasko; e Papa wa kubalilapo ukwingila mu mosque.
The coast of the Phoenicians, whose ceda: Ululamba lwa Bafoinike, ifimuti fyabo ifya sedari e fyabomfiwe mu Tempele lya kwa Solomone. Yesu aile ku fifulo fya Tiro na Sidoni, na Elia aikele no mukamfwilwa ku Sarefati.
King Hiram of Tyre sends cedars of Leban: Hiramu, imfumu ya Tiro, atumine ifimuti fya sedari ifya ku Lebanoni ku kukuula Itempele lya kwa Solomone (1 Kings 5).
Elijah is fed by the widow of Zarephath: Elia alishiwe no mukamfwilwa wa ku Sarefati, kabili abuushishe umwana wakwe (1 Kings 17:8-24; Luke 4:25-26).
The Psalms and the Song of Songs praise: Amalumbo no Lwimbo lwa Nyimbo fitasha ifimuti fya sedari ne finunkila fya Lebanoni (Psalm 104:16; Song of Songs 4:8-15).
Jesus heals the daughter of a Syrophoeni: Yesu aposhishe umwana umwanakashi uwa mwanakashi umuSirofoinike mu fifulo fya Tiro (Mark 7:24-30).
Lebanon is home of the Maronite Catholic: Lebanoni e kwabo kwa Calici ca Katolika ica Bamaroni, ico Patriarka waciko aba ku Bkerke, kabili e kwabo na kwa Bakatolika Abamelkiti, Abasiria na Abaarmenia.
The Kadisha Valley, the 'Holy Valley' be: Umupokapoka wa Qadisha, “Umupokapoka wa Mushilo” pe samba lya Fimuti fya Sedari fya kwa Lesa, wali ubutubukilo bwa bapepi abaitalusha na kwabo kwa bamonaki Abamaroni pa myanda ya myaka iingi.
Lebanese saints include St Charbel Makhl: Pa batakatifu ba ku Lebanoni paliko Mutakatifu Sharbel Makhlouf, Mutakatifu Rafqa na Mutakatifu Nimatullah al-Hardini.
More New Testament places lie in Turkey: Turkey yalikwata incende ishingi isha Cipangano Cipya ukucila icalo cimbi conse kano Icalo ca Mushilo: Tarso uko Paulo afyalilwe, Antiokia, Efeso, Amacalici ya Galatia na Macalici cinelubali aya Ukusokolola.
Noah's ark comes to rest 'on the mountai: Ubwato bwa kwa Noa bwaiminine “pa mpili sha Ararati” (Genesis 8:4).
Abraham lives at Haran before setting ou: Abrahamu aikele ku Harani ilyo ashilaya ku Kanaani (Genesis 11:31 - 12:5).
Paul is born at Tarsus in Cilicia (Acts: Paulo afyalilwe mu Tarso wa ku Kilikia (Acts 22:3). Ku Antiokia e ko abasambi batendeke ukwitwa abena Kristu (Acts 11:26).
Paul's journeys take him through Pisidia: Ifyendo fya kwa Paulo fyamufikishe ku Antiokia wa ku Pisidia, Ikonio, Listra na Derbe (Acts 13-14), kabili alembeele Abagalatia (Galatians 1:2).
1 Peter is addressed to Christians in Po: Kalata wa kubalilapo uwa kwa Petro alembelwe abena Kristu aba ku Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia na Bitinia (1 Peter 1:1).
Revelation is written to seven churches: Ukusokolola kwalembelwe Amacalici cinelubali aya ku Asia: Efeso, Smurna, Pergamo, Tiatira, Sarde, Filadelfia na Laodikea (Revelation 1:11).
The first ecumenical councils, at Nicaea: Ukulongana kukalamba ukwa kubalilapo ukwa Calici kwali ku Nikaea (325), Konstantinopoli (381), Efeso (431) na Kalsedoni (451), mu Turkey wa lelo.
Tradition holds that St John brought the: Ukulingana ne ntambi, Mutakatifu Yohane asendele Maria Umunakashi ukumutwala ku Efeso (John 19:27).
St John XXIII served in Istanbul as the: Mutakatifu Yohane XXIII abombele nga kapokelela wa Papa ku Istanbul ukutula mu 1935 ukufika mu 1944. Amabumba ayanono aya Bakatolika ba Cilatini, Abaarmenia, Bakaldea na Basiria yacilipo.
Paul first brought the Gospel to Europe: Pano Paulo e po atendeke ukuleta Ilyashi Lisuma ku Bulaya, ku Filipi, pa numa ku Tesalonika, Atene na Korinti. Icipangano Cipya cine calembelwe mu ciGriki.
Daniel's vision of the goat stands for ': Mu fimonwa fya kwa Daniele, umunani wa mbushi “e mfumu ya Griki”, Aleksandere Mukalamba (Daniel 8:21). Icitabo ca kubalilapo ica Bamakabe citendeka ne fyo Aleksandere acimfishe (1 Maccabees 1:1-9).
Jonathan Maccabeus writes to the Spartan: Yonatani Makabe alembeele Abaspata pa kuti bapilibule ubucibusa (1 Maccabees 12:1-23).
In a vision a Macedonian begs Paul, 'Com: Mu cimonwa, umuntu umuMakedonia apapatile Paulo ati: “Abuka wise ku Makedonia utwafwe!” (Acts 16:9).
Paul founds churches at Philippi, Thessa: Paulo atendeke Amacalici ku Filipi, Tesalonika, Berea na Korinti, kabili ashimikile ku Atene (Acts 16-18).
John receives the Book of Revelation on: Yohane apokelele Ukusokolola pa cishi ca Patmo (Revelation 1:9).
Sts Cyril and Methodius, apostles to the: Bamutakatifu Sirilo na Metodio, abatumwa ba Baslavi na bakaele ba Bulaya, bafyalilwe ku Tesalonika.
St John Paul II visited the Areopagus in: Mutakatifu Yohane Paulo II atandalile mu 2001 Areopago ku Atene, uko Paulo ashimikile.
Greece has small Latin and Greek Byzanti: Griki yalikwata amabumba ayanono aya Bakatolika ba Cilatini na ba ntambi ya ciGriki-Bizanti. Icalici Cikalamba ica Katolika ku Atene capeelwa kuli Mutakatifu Dionisio wa ku Areopago, uo Paulo alengele ukusumina (Acts 17:34).
Rome, capital of the empire, received Pa: Roma, umusumba ukalamba uwa bufumu, wapokelele Paulo nga kaili; ukulingana ne ntambi ya kale, Petro na Paulo bafwilile kuno nga bakamboni ba citetekelo. Papa, impyani ya kwa Petro, acaikala kuno.
Judas Maccabeus makes a treaty of friend: Yuda Makabe acitile icipangano ca bucibusa na Baroma (1 Maccabees 8:17-32).
Visitors from Rome are in Jerusalem at P: Pa Pentekoste palikwete abeni abafumine ku Roma mu Yerusalemu (Acts 2:10).
Paul writes his Letter to the Romans bef: Paulo alembeele Abaroma ilyo ashilafika (Romans 1:7-15), pa numa, nga kaili, afikile ku Regio na Puteoli ilyo aleya ku Roma (Acts 28:13-16).
Hebrews sends greetings from 'those from: Kalata ku Bahebere atuma imitende ukufuma kuli “abo aba ku Italia” (Hebrews 13:24).
Tradition holds that Peter was crucified: Ukulingana ne ntambi, Petro abambilwe pa lupili lwa Vatikani, na Paulo aputwilwe umutwe pa nse ya fibumba mu musebo wa ku Ostia, nalimo mu mwaka wa 64-67, mu nshiku sha kwa Nero.
St Peter's Basilica stands over Peter's: Icalici Cikalamba ica Mutakatifu Petro caimina pa nshishi ya kwa Petro, ne Calici Cikalamba ica Mutakatifu Paulo pa Nse ya Fibumba pa nshishi ya kwa Paulo.
Vatican City, inside Rome, is the seat o: Icalo ca Musumba wa Vatikani, icaba mu Roma, e kwabo kwa Papa.
The island where Paul was shipwrecked on: Icishi uko ubwato bwa kwa Paulo bwatobekele ilyo aleya ku Roma. Apuswike ku kulumwa ne nsoka, kabili aposhishe wishi wa kwa Publio, umukalamba wa cishi.
The ship carrying Paul runs aground and: Ubwato ubwasendele Paulo bwaiminine pa musenga, kabili abantu bonse 276 abali muli bwena bafikile pa mulundu nabakaba no mweo (Acts 27:37-44).
The islanders show 'extraordinary kindne: Abantu ba pa cishi balangile “ubuntu ubushaba bwa lyonse”. Insoka yalumine Paulo, lelo tacamucitile kantu (Acts 28:1-6).
Paul heals Publius's father and many oth: Paulo aposhishe wishi wa kwa Publio na bambi abengi, kabili aikeleko imyeshi itatu (Acts 28:7-11).
